how_scores_work: Each version gets up to 100 points: evidence that people have this problem (30 points), fit with your skills, budget and time (25 points), places to reach these customers (20 points), can be built as a first version (15 points), room next to existing options (10 points). These weights are design choices, not facts (config/scoring.toml).

versions.name: Payment Checklist Guide
versions.verdict: Held back because it needs at least 3 real examples of the problem (has 2).

points.Evidence that people have this problem: 12 of 30: Found 2 real examples of people describing this problem or looking for help with it, on reallygooddesigns.com and winvesta.in. Full marks need 5. For example: “Freelance designers struggle with late payments” / “Freelance designers look for tools to streamline payment processes”.
points.Fit with your skills, budget and time: 25 of 25: You already have what it takes for writing and google docs; it needs about 10 hours (you have about 24 a month) and about $0 (your budget is $150).
points.Places to reach these customers: 13 of 20: These customers can be found on ryrob.com and upwork.com.
points.Can be built as a first version: 15 of 15: It's a written guide (an e-book or PDF), which the team can build, and it fits in about a month of your time.
points.Room next to existing options: 2 of 10: Found 3 existing options but no complaints about them. Complaints show where you could do better.
